nodes.name: Booking Complete Webhook
Booking Accepted?
nodes.notes:
Only continue if the caller actually said yes to the quote.
Anything else is logged and acknowledged, but never booked.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ caller_name: $json.body.booking_data.caller_name, caller_phone: $json.body.booking_data.caller_phone, caller_email: $json.body.booking_data.caller_email, pickup_address: $json.body.booking_data.pickup_address, dropoff_address: $json.body.booking_data.dropoff_address, weight_kg: $json.body.booking_data.weight_kg, date: $json.body.booking_data.date, time: $json.body.booking_data.time, quote_gbp: $json.body.booking_data.quote_gbp, distance_miles: $json.body.booking_data.distance_miles, call_id: $json.body.call_id }) }}

nodes.name: Create Booking
nodes.notes:
Calls FastAPI, which does the calendar, spreadsheet, SMS and emails.

IF N8N RUNS IN DOCKER, localhost points at the container, not your PC.
Change the URL to http://host.docker.internal:8000/booking/create

onError=continueRegularOutput means a 4xx/5xx flows to the next node
instead of stopping the workflow, so the failure branch can run.

nodes.name: Booking Created OK?
nodes.notes:
FastAPI returns ok:true plus a per-step breakdown.
If the request failed entirely there is no ok field, so this goes false.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, reference: $json.reference, message: $json.message, steps: $json.steps }) }}

nodes.name: Respond Success
nodes.notes: Returns the booking reference, e.g. CRR-20260915-K7Q4

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ reason: 'Booking creation failed: ' + ($json.error ? JSON.stringify($json.error) : 'unknown error'), details: $('Booking Complete Webhook').item.json.body.booking_data || {} }) }}

nodes.name: Alert Client
nodes.notes:
FastAPI sends the alert email using the SMTP details in .env,
so n8n does not need its own mail credentials.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, message: 'Booking failed - the client has been alerted by email.' }) }}
